- ECG
- Health metrics and measurements
- IRN
- Location
- Logged symptoms
- Mindfulness
- Nutrition
- Profile
- Reproductive health
- Settings
- Sleep

The connection is verified, but no health data has been imported yet. The next step would be to import history or run a sync. Some types, such as nutrition, ECG, and symptoms, are not yet confirmed against a live account, so they may return little or no data.
